talents.name: Annihilation
talents.effect: No GCD. Next 5 direct hits are guaranteed crits (12s). No damage. Grants Sculptor of Doom via The True Blessing. Used when Sculptor is down, Felfury >= 2, Inner Demon and Bane are up.

talents.name: Hateforged Barrier
talents.effect: Absorb shield. Unused in stationary fights.

talents.name: Cruelty
talents.effect: +4% crit (+6% vs Demons; raid boss is not treated as a Demon).

talents.name: Felwracked
talents.effect: Every 3rd Fel Fireball within 15s generates 1 extra Felfury.

talents.name: Embracing Evil
talents.effect: Banes last 20% longer and cost 20% less Energy.

talents.name: Skull of Gul'dan
talents.effect: No GCD. +37.5% max Energy for 10s with Gul'dan's Gift. Base 1 min CD, 1.5 min with Gift. Used with Annihilation for Archimonde's Wrath.

talents.name: Demonic Embrace
talents.effect: Inner Demon at 6+ Felfury restores 50 Energy.

talents.name: Gul'dan's Gift
talents.effect: Skull of Gul'dan +50% effect and +50% cooldown (1 min → 1.5 min).

talents.name: Elemental Bane
talents.effect: +10% crit damage. +15% crit vs Elementals not applied to the raid dummy.

talents.name: Reckoning
talents.effect: No GCD. 10s free instant Fireballs and +4% damage / 15s per Fireball, max 4. 2 min CD. Used when Felforged is down and Felfury is below 3.

talents.name: Blood of Mannoroth
talents.effect: No GCD. Gain 6 Felfury and +100% Energy regen for 20s. 3 min CD. Used after Inner Demon is up.

talents.name: Chaotic
talents.effect: 8% on dealing damage: +3% damage for 8s, stacks 3.
